name: GEF Small Grants Programme Philippines (SGP8)
summary: The Philippines' SGP8 country programme, run by Forest Foundation Philippines with UNDP, offers NGO hub, strategic, regular and planning grants to registered NGOs and community-based organisations in selected landscapes and seascapes.

administered_by.quote: SGP8 will be implemented by Forest Foundation Philippines as the Project Management Unit, in partnership with UNDP Philippines

applicant_types.quote: Community-based organizations (CBOs) such as user groups, Indigenous Peoples' groups, women's groups, and/or youth groups

geography.quote: Be reminded that all NGOs and CBOs must be duly registered under the Philippine laws.

access.quote: Apply for a grant and partner with us to empower community-driven conservation initiatives!

amount.quote: Strategic grants may amount to up to US$ 150,000 or pesos equivalent.
